verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs include Alerts, Ownership Rules, and Fingerprint Rules pages, plus Slack, PagerDuty, and webhook integrations that rule-driven alerts could route to. Seer can also send root-cause analysis to coding agents for automated fix and PR generation. However, the evidence is mostly page titles, with no description of rule conditions, triggers, or configurable action types, so the depth of event-to-action automation is unproven. Missing for 10: documented rule condition/action semantics (e.g., alert rule triggers and actions), evidence of AI-native rule definition via API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
